verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with its own case-management platform, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question for this kind of SaaS service. The evidence shows no public API: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all return 404, the llms.txt probe returns 404, and the docs never mention API keys, tokens, or permission scoping. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability means none.
